items.title: Why Community is Key at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>CNCF Ambassador Orlin Vasilev shares why the greatest value of KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America is connecting face-to-face with project maintainers and building real community relationships.

For platform engineers and open source contributors, gathering in person provides a unique opportunity to meet core project maintainers, exchange insights, and understand the future direction of essential cloud native tools straight from the source.

Register for KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America:

#KubeCon #CloudNative #OpenSource #CNCF #PlatformEngineering</article>

items.title: Meet Kevin Klues - Speaker at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>Memory-coherent hardware gives applications a unified address space across CPU and GPU memory. It also challenges assumptions built into Kubernetes.

At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon North America, Kevin Klues of NVIDIA will examine the failures uncovered by this new memory model, the path to Coherent Driver-based Memory Management and the patches still needed for reliable Kubernetes operation.

Explore the session: https://bit.ly/4yywyog

Join us November 9-12 in Salt Lake City.

Register: https://bit.ly/3BDI5XL</article>

items.title: Why the Community Keeps Returning to KubeCon + CloudNativeCon
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>The talks are great, but the community is why people keep coming back to KubeCon + CloudNativeCon.

Cloud security and AI practitioner Zdeněk Váňa highlights why the hallway track and peer networking are the true highlights of the event. While technical sessions deliver valuable knowledge, meeting the people behind the projects creates lasting connections and sparks new open source collaborations.

Whether you want to discuss cloud security, AI infrastructure, or modern platform engineering, KubeCon + CloudNativeCon brings together the engineers building the future of open source technology.

Register now to secure your spot at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon: https://bit.ly/4z2FJO6

#Shorts #KubeCon #CloudNative #OpenSource #DevOps</article>

items.title: Cloud Native Live: Compliance at Scale with Kyverno - Razorpay and Nirmata
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>Razorpay processes over $180 billion in payments annually and powers 80 of India’s top 100 unicorns. Operating at this scale in a regulated financial market means meeting strict Reserve Bank of India (RBI) requirements while maintaining 99.99% system availability and releasing new features quickly.

In this fireside chat, Ashwath Kumar (Head of Security at Razorpay) and Jim Bugwadia (CEO at Nirmata) share how Razorpay automated its security policies. By adopting Kyverno Razorpay moved from manual audits to continuous, automated compliance across its entire infrastructure. They will also discuss how active involvement in the CNCF community helps their business.</article>
